methodology.scope: Differentiate equivalence, weighted aggregation, dominance, abstraction and physical realization; no universal collapse claim.

assessment_policy: Correctness, contribution, priority and fertility are separate. The constructive physical update and finite hardware/noise frontier are concrete contributions enabled by established instruments.

branch_additions.title: Costed continuation update circuits
branch_additions.hypothesis: A task-relative continuation signature can be physically updated with a minimum shared circuit cost that changes with incoming code geometry and noise.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: A sufficient semantic bit or evaluator signature is treated as freely available after a new observation.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Same two-stage plant, initial noisy code, real readable syndrome, shared NAND update and output-write noise; independently enumerate functions and physical traces.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: Minimum-cost physical netlist, strict lower-bound witness, full noise-interval certificate and explicit faulty-gate counterexample.
branch_additions.contribution: Executed synthesis of 5824 encoder/function pairs, 2814 exact dominance checks; two versus four gates create different realizable noise thresholds.

branch_updates.evidence: A real update combines the transported diagnostic and fresh syndrome, writes a single action bit and supports an exact risk bound; no hidden health reaches the circuit.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Refine the continuation signature when individual gate faults change dependencies between available signals; then recurrent updates.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: Ideal truth-function equivalence is reused as if it preserved the noisy joint law.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Two noiselessly equivalent DAGs with declared independent/shared faults; preserve necessary signal correlations.

branch_updates.evidence: A single shared gate network implements all update rows; exact minimum capacities of two and four gates are certified in distinct noise regimes.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Shared multioutput read/write/selection circuits and actual installation/maintenance costs beyond gate-slot capacity.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: Separate rowwise minimization or arbitrary decoder remapping supplies an unavailable joint program.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Compare two whole circuit libraries, charge common subcircuits once, prove minimal achievable upgrade.

rejected_additions.claim: Noiseless truth-equivalent circuit prefixes can be merged unchanged when the analysis adds internal gate faults.
rejected_additions.reason: An ideal wire and two NAND inversions implement the same truth function; with independent flip probability gamma in each gate, the latter has output error 2gamma(1-gamma), e.g.18% at gamma=.1. The safe continuation equivalence must include the fault contract and signal dependencies.
